_comment: Fixes to Lurch's pack, applied by tools/poptracker_add_map.py to its COPY before any map is added.
Each replace is a regex with the exact number of matches expected in that file. A different count
means the pack changed underneath us: the run stops and names the fix instead of patching blind.
Written against Lurch's 0.0.9 (2026-10-29). He fixed Stone Club / Cooking Pot mapping, RifleOK,
useNets and the Raw Prime Fish Meat x10 path himself in 0.0.9, so those fixes were dropped.
Left alone on purpose: 'no yet in use' on Plant Species Y Trap x20 is a visibility rule that hides
a check the apworld does not have (only Plant Species Y Seed x20 exists). Also $carnoIsland on four
Carno Cave notes: no such function exists anywhere and its intent is Lurch's call.

uncomment.why: The whole Scorched Earth tab is commented out in 0.0.8 and 0.0.9, so its map and three caves (all wired in his pack) never showed. Justin 2026-10-29: show it.

Canoe (8730595) mapping commented out, so receiving it never ticked

lower-case u; logic.lua defines UseGrapple

0.0.9 note rules reference the Island exploration sections without the space the group's name has
same missing space inside the section name 'Visit South Haven (Herbie Island)'
same missing space inside 'Visit The Dead Island (Carno Island)'
Mining Drill (8730582) commented out although items.json defines it as code `drill`; receiving it never ticked
Metal Sickle (8730211) commented out although 0.0.9's items.json defines it as code `sickle`
Fiber x1500 names `metal_sickle`, which is not an item; 0.0.9's Metal Sickle item is `sickle`

same: the chest code is fur_chest (item_mapping 8730168)

Ankylosaurus tame; logic.lua defines UseNets
all five Beelzebufo tame alternatives misspell its unlock code (items.json: beelzebufo)
Electronics: a location reference written with $ (function) instead of @
Kill Species x100: no DeepFightTames function; logic.lua's combat-capable deep tames are deep_tames_combat

replace.repl:
-- Die N times sections show while op_DM is on. Turn it on when slot_data says so, OR when the
    -- slot's included_locations (already read above, and reliable) holds any of the five death
    -- count checks (8751039-8751043): seeds from before the option send no key, and the setting
    -- toggles stayed dark even with death_milestones = true (2026-11-01, slot GhiosTesting)
    local dm_obj = Tracker:FindObjectForCode("op_DM")
    if dm_obj then
        local v = slot_data['death_milestones']
        local on = (v == true or v == 1 or v == "true" or v == "True")
        for id = 8751039, 8751043 do
            if INCLUDED_LOCATIONS[id] then on = true end
        end
        dm_obj.Active = on
    end
replace.why: the five Die N times sections show only while op_DM is on, and op_DM only turned on from slot_data['death_milestones']. A seed generated before that option existed sends no key, so the checks were in the seed but hidden in the tracker (Justin 2026-10-31). Now also from included_locations, since toggles stayed dark even with death_milestones = true

replace.pattern: \n-- resets an item to its initial state\n
replace.repl:
-- Die N times sections (milestones.json visibility). Shown while the op_DM setting is on (slot_data
-- or a manual click) OR when the slot's included_locations holds one of the five death count checks.
-- The second path reads the same table the death sanity sections use and does not depend on the
-- toggle, which stayed dark on a live slot even with death_milestones = true.
function death_milestones_enabled()
    local dm_obj = Tracker:FindObjectForCode("op_DM")
    if dm_obj and dm_obj.Active then
        return true
    end
    for id = 8751039, 8751043 do
        if INCLUDED_LOCATIONS[id] then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- resets an item to its initial state
replace.why: the Die N times sections stayed hidden with death_milestones = true and all five ids in included_locations (live slot GhiosTesting, 2026-11-01): the op_DM toggle never lit. Visibility now goes through a function that also reads included_locations directly
the five Die N times sections: visibility via death_milestones_enabled (see the archipelago.lua fix above) instead of the bare op_DM toggle
